subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery land as a focused `channel-info`/`channel-list` change, or continue through the broad Slack action-parity PR?
rationale: The feature is valid and source-reproducible, but the active implementation path is broad, protected, conflicting, and security/proof blocked, so queuing duplicate repair without maintainer direction would create churn.

options.title: Split focused discovery work
options.body: Land a small Slack plugin PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, leaving search and broader Slack actions for separate review.

options.title: Continue broad parity PR
options.body: Use the open broad Slack parity PR as the canonical path, but require its security, proof, and mergeability blockers to be resolved before closing this issue.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery
options.body: Keep this accepted feature request open without queuing repair until maintainers are ready to expand the Slack action surface.

recommendation.title: Split focused discovery work
recommendation.body: Land a small Slack plugin PR for only `channel-info` and `channel-list`, leaving search and broader Slack actions for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the open broad Slack parity PR and has the strongest recent Slack action/docs history among the routing candidates.
